message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine titled "TEMPO". The word "TEMPO" is printed in large, black, serif capital letters at the top center. Below it, the date "26 JANUARI-1 FEBRUARI 2015" is visible. Above the title, two lines of text are separated by a diagonal slash. The left side reads "PELURU UNTUK AKTIVIS ANTIKORUPSI BANGKALAN" and the right reads "BENARKAH AIRBUS 320 AIRASIA TAK LAYAK TERBANG".

The main visual area features several black animal silhouettes and one red silhouette on a white background. A large black snake silhouette curves around the top and right sides, framing the central content. Its head points toward the bottom right. Inside this frame, the bold text "KPK ADALAH KITA" is followed by a sentence: "Setelah menetapkan Budi Gunawan sebagai tersangka, KPK digebuk dari pelbagai penjuru."

The silhouettes include a large crocodile with its mouth closed and visible white eye slits, a spider, a scorpion, a cockroach, two millipedes, and a small red lizard. The crocodile occupies the lower left quadrant. To its right are the scorpion, spider, cockroach, and millipedes. The red lizard is at the bottom. A barcode, the price "RP 39.500", and other publishing details are in the bottom right corner.
